slot.brief: Evaluate a composite like sin^{-1}(sin x) outside the principal range or tan^{-1}a + tan^{-1}b using the right-triangle method and quadrant care

verdicts.working: Both angles are in quadrant I, and their sum is in quadrant II. Its tangent is $(2+3)/(1-2\cdot3)=-1$, so the sum is $3\pi/4$ and its cosine is $-1/\sqrt{2}$.

working:
Let $\theta=\tan^{-1}2+\tan^{-1}3$. Then $\tan\theta=\dfrac{2+3}{1-6}=-1$\nBoth angles are in quadrant I and their sum is in quadrant II.\nHence $\cos\theta=-\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{1+\tan^2\theta}}=-\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}}$.
